answer: Yes, this is a real bug. Root cause: when a request is preempted in sim/batch_formation.go:preemptForTokens(), its ProgressIndex is reset to 0 (line 232). When the request is rescheduled, it re-enters the decode phase and each regenerated output token increments sim.Metrics.TotalOutputTokens again (sim/simulator.go:647), double-counting tokens already counted before preemption. The fix captures the number of decode tokens generated before preemption (ProgressIndex - len(InputTokens)) in PreemptedRequest.GeneratedOutputTokens, and subtracts that count from TotalOutputTokens when recording preemption metrics in scheduleBatch(). This ensures each output token is counted exactly once regardless of preemption.
